verdict.rationale: Wave's docs say it generates the profit & loss statement, balance sheet, and cash flow report automatically. Its reports offer month-to-month and year-to-year comparisons, and real double-entry accounting underpins the accuracy claim. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of arbitrary custom date ranges for 'any period', clarity on whether the statements require the Pro tier (the claim appears on the /pro page), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the reports are accurate.
